messages:
Maya (PM): quick one — we need to sequence compliance work for the next PI. scoped items: SOC2 gap fixes, ISO readiness, BYOK/KMS handshake, and audit-log export. customers pushing: AlphaBank (finserv), GovPilot (gov). asking: risk-weighting + launch gates. who can propose phases?

Daniel (Eng): +1. need clarity on which features are hard gates vs. nice-to-have. BYOK + escrow will impact infra timeline.

Priya (Security): From a controls POV: SOC2 must-have: immutable audit stream, access logging, and key rotation policy. ISO adds documentation + defined runbooks. BYOK/escrow can be staged (pilot -> GA).

Luis (Product): proposal sketch: Phase 0 (PI1): SOC2 critical fixes + immutable audit stream (low-latency export). Phase 1 (PI2): BYOK handshake + tenant keystore onboarding (pilot customers). Phase 2 (PI3): ISO docs + expanded retention SLAs and region parity. thoughts?

Sam (Sales): AlphaBank requires BYOK pilot + 12m retention SLA in contract. GovPilot needs Fed-region-only logs and evidence export in 30 days. Both are willing to sign if pilot timeline is clear.

Anya (Legal): for contract language we need retention buckets + legal-hold escape hatch. also need to define evidence export format (JSONL + signed manifest) and SLA for delivery.

Daniel (Eng): technical asks: BYOK pilot needs KMS integration (bring-your-own-key and wrap/unwrap flow), HSM support for escrow, and an export pipeline with signed manifests. estimate: pilot infra work ~3 sprints if no major refactor.

Maya (PM): pragmatic gating suggestion: gate1 = SOC2 critical controls + export pipeline (must for GA). gate2 = BYOK pilot (GA for paid customers in next quarter). gate3 = ISO readiness + expanded retention tiers. This keeps SOC2 first while giving sales a clear pilot path.

Priya (Security): agree. also add automated smoke tests for audit integrity and a weekly drift check. we should tie rollout to a regression eval (sample prompt sets) to ensure no leakage in logs.

Luis (Product): ok to add customer-facing acceptance criteria: 1) export manifest schema published, 2) BYOK handshake doc + test certs, 3) retention toggle UI in Console (beta).

Sam (Sales): i'll draft a one-pager for AlphaBank with pilot milestones + acceptance gates. want to be explicit about dates.

Anya (Legal): i'll put together required contract language snippets for retention + legal hold. need inputs on timelines from eng.

Daniel (Eng): can we get a prioritized ticket list? i'll slot engineering rough estimates once we have that.

Maya (PM): action items: @Sam draft customer one-pager by EOD Tue, @Daniel create initial infra estimate by Thu, @Priya define smoke test matrix by Thu, @Anya produce contract snippets by Fri. ops-bot: create backlog epic 'compliance: staged-launch sequencing' and assign. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Epic created: COMP-3210 'compliance: staged-launch sequencing' (link: https://rwinf.atlassian/COMP-3210). Epic owner: Maya.

Luis (Product): +1. We'll run a quick sync Wed to align PI planning.

Maya (PM): thanks all — meeting Wed 10am to finalize phase list and gating metrics. :calendar:
file_description: Thread to align phase sequencing, risk-weighting, and customer triage for compliance work (SOC2, ISO, BYOK, retention).
